en.headline: Velclaw documentation, traced to the source repository.
en.intro: This documentation records implementation facts verified against Velclaw 2.0.0 and its source tree. Planned behavior remains explicitly labelled when it is not implemented or released.
en.quickStartText: The repository is a private Next.js 16 application using React 19 and TypeScript. The lockfile is pnpm v9. Current CI and deployment configuration are recorded in the source tree.
en.setupNotice: package.json defines dev, build, start, lint, type-check, format, database migration, and database studio scripts. CI workflows are present under .github/workflows/.
en.architectureText: The application uses Next.js App Router routes under app/, reusable UI under components/, server/data/security code under lib/ and server/, database configuration and migrations, and self-hosted deployment assets under deploy/.
en.workspaceNote: projects, repos, tasks and Velclaw application surfaces are present
en.agentsNote: sandbox agent implementations and connector integrations are present
en.projectsNote: app/, components/, lib/, server/, and database-related code are present
en.buildNote: Next.js webpack build plus GitHub Actions workflows are present
en.capabilitiesText: These areas are supported by concrete source-tree evidence. Individual features can still depend on configuration, credentials, or external services.
